prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Create a NEW boss-only design review sheet for a 2D side-scrolling fantasy RPG. Reference image 1 (playable lineage showcase) is the STRICT rendering and proportion authority. Reference image 2 is ONLY the old boss identity reference; its overly realistic rendering is exactly what must be replaced.
Make bosses convincingly belong to the same sprite family as reference 1: compact storybook chibi anatomy, oversized expressive heads, short chunky limbs, clean dark outer contours, broad flat local-color shapes, only two or three soft cel-painted shade values, smooth surfaces, sparse purposeful interior lines. Match the actual small hero cutouts, not elaborate concept-art illustration. A boss is a physically larger character in the SAME style, not a realistic monster next to a cartoon. For humanoids use about 3.5 heads in total height excluding crown, wide feet, simple face, big hands, no realistic musculature. For beasts use oversized heads and paws, exaggerated single-read silhouette, broad grouped fur/feathers/scales, NO individual hair or scale rendering. Wood is broad smooth planes with a few cracks. Metal is simple colored plates with one broad highlight. Remain imposing through size, stance and silhouette, not horror textures. Avoid mature anime, 3D render, photorealism, engraved filigree, fine crosshatching, cinematic lighting and noisy painting.
Presentation: plain muted blue-grey backdrop, simple oval ground shadow, thin understated navy panel dividers, cream readable boss name only at top of each panel. FULL BODY all weapons and tails/wings visible, generous padding. Side-on or slight side-three-quarter playable pose facing left, no perspective foreshortening. Include a SMALL unchanged-style hero silhouette from reference 1 beside each boss on same baseline, labeled "Hero scale", around one-third boss height, as a STYLE and SIZE comparison only. Do not redesign the heroes. No detailed environment, HUD, health bars, moodboard panels, props gallery or paragraphs. Each boss appears once. This is a pending style review, not an approved moodboard.
